From The Stewards      Document 48 
  
To All Officials, All Teams      Date  12 September 2026 
 
        Time  18:43 
  
 
The lap time set by the F1 car that went through the double waved yellow flag marshalling sector will be deleted as 
detailed in Article B1.8.4b of the FIA F1 Regulations: 
 
Session Qualifying 
  
Fact The F1 car passed through a double waved yellow flag marshalling sector. 
 
No. Turn Car Driver Competitor Time of Day Lap Time 
1 11 10 Pierre Gasly BWT Alpine F1 Team 16:28:33 PIT 
 
 
Decision Deletion of the lap time shown in accordance with Article 12.4.1.e of the FIA International 
Sporting Code.   
Note Competitors are reminded that they have the right to appeal
